</section>
<section id="S4.SS4" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">4.4 </span>Loss, distillation, and clustering during training</h3>

<div id="S4.SS4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Both the <math id="S4.SS4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d=64" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>64</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d=64</annotation></semantics></math> branch and the <math id="S4.SS4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d=2048" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2048</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d=2048</annotation></semantics></math> branch are trained. Candidates on the narrow branch are clustered as they will be at indexing time, and the score uses those centroids.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.p2.1" class="ltx_p">The candidate pool of a query is the other documents in the batch plus its own hard negatives. Three kinds of candidate are excluded from the negative set (other positives of the same query stay positives, samples from another source leave this loss, and candidates scored at least as high as the positive by the teacher leave the negatives), and every remaining candidate in the pool is a negative. Let <math id="S4.SS4.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pi_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>π</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi_{i}</annotation></semantics></math> be the softmax probability of the positive. A focal weight emphasizes queries that are not yet separated.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.p3" class="ltx_para">
<table id="S4.E4" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.E4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{focal}}=\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{batch}}\big[a_{i}\,(-\log\pi_{i})\big],\quad a_{i}=\frac{\operatorname{sg}\!\big((1-\pi_{i})^{\gamma}\big)}{\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{batch}}\!\big[\operatorname{sg}((1-\pi_{j})^{\gamma})\big]},\quad\gamma=1." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>focal</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝔼</mi><mi>batch</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mo rspace="0.167em">−</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.812em;" width="0.812em"><mi>sg</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi>γ</mi></msup><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>𝔼</mi><mi>batch</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">[</mo><mrow><mi>sg</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mi>j</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi>γ</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>γ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{focal}}=\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{batch}}\big[a_{i}\,(-\log\pi_{i})\big],\quad a_{i}=\frac{\operatorname{sg}\!\big((1-\pi_{i})^{\gamma}\big)}{\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{batch}}\!\big[\operatorname{sg}((1-\pi_{j})^{\gamma})\big]},\quad\gamma=1.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(4)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S4.SS4.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><math id="S4.SS4.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{sg}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>sg</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{sg}</annotation></semantics></math> stops the gradient through <math id="S4.SS4.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a_{i}</annotation></semantics></math>, so the weight is a constant with respect to the parameters. Dividing by the batch mean keeps the average weight at <math id="S4.SS4.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>1</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math>, so the scale of the loss does not follow how hard the batch is. Bidirectional samples add the reverse cross-entropy <math id="S4.SS4.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{d\to q}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>q</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{d\to q}</annotation></semantics></math> with weight <math id="S4.SS4.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=0.5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta=0.5</annotation></semantics></math>. Ordered pairs, including a forward clip against its reverse and negatives that have been graded, add a pairwise term <math id="S4.SS4.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ord}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>ord</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ord}}</annotation></semantics></math>. The gradient through the higher score <math id="S4.SS4.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s_{0}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>s</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s_{0}</annotation></semantics></math> is stopped, so only the lower score <math id="S4.SS4.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>s</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s_{1}</annotation></semantics></math> is decreased. The retrieval loss on one branch is</p>
<table id="S4.E5" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.E5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ret}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{focal}}+\beta\,\mathcal{L}_{d\to q}+\lambda_{\mathrm{ord}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ord}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>ret</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>focal</mi></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>q</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>ord</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>ord</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ret}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{focal}}+\beta\,\mathcal{L}_{d\to q}+\lambda_{\mathrm{ord}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ord}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(5)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.p4.1" class="ltx_p">The distillation target mixes the model’s internal <math id="S4.SS4.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d=2048" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2048</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d=2048</annotation></semantics></math> scores <math id="S4.SS4.p4.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s^{\mathrm{in}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>s</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s^{\mathrm{in}}</annotation></semantics></math> with external teacher scores <math id="S4.SS4.p4.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s^{\mathrm{te}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>s</mi><mi>te</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s^{\mathrm{te}}</annotation></semantics></math>. Both are standardized on the valid candidates. With mixture weight <math id="S4.SS4.p4.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w_{e}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w_{e}</annotation></semantics></math>, the target is placed back on the scale of <math id="S4.SS4.p4.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s^{\mathrm{in}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>s</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s^{\mathrm{in}}</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="S4.Ex1" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.Ex1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{s}^{\mathrm{te}}=\mu_{\mathrm{in}}+\sigma_{\mathrm{in}}\big((1-w_{e})\hat{z}(s^{\mathrm{in}})+w_{e}\hat{z}(s^{\mathrm{te}})\big)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mover accent="true"><mi>s</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mi>te</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>in</mi></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>in</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>z</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>s</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>z</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>s</mi><mi>te</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{s}^{\mathrm{te}}=\mu_{\mathrm{in}}+\sigma_{\mathrm{in}}\big((1-w_{e})\hat{z}(s^{\mathrm{in}})+w_{e}\hat{z}(s^{\mathrm{te}})\big).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S4.SS4.p4.2" class="ltx_p">The distillation loss is a KL divergence between the teacher and student rankings plus a margin term,</p>
<table id="S4.E6" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.E6.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{kd}}=c_{i}\Big[\operatorname{KL}\!\big(p^{\mathrm{te}}\,\|\,p^{\mathrm{stu}}\big)+\lambda_{\mathrm{margin}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{margin}}\Big]," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>kd</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">[</mo><mpadded style="width:1.431em;" width="1.431em"><mi>KL</mi></mpadded><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>te</mi></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.337em">∥</mo><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>stu</mi></msup><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>margin</mi></msub><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>margin</mi></msub><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{kd}}=c_{i}\Big[\operatorname{KL}\!\big(p^{\mathrm{te}}\,\|\,p^{\mathrm{stu}}\big)+\lambda_{\mathrm{margin}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{margin}}\Big],</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(6)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S4.SS4.p4.3" class="ltx_p">where <math id="S4.SS4.p4.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{i}</annotation></semantics></math> is larger when the teacher distribution has lower entropy.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.p5.1" class="ltx_p">An external teacher may have dimension <math id="S4.SS4.p5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d_{T}=4096" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>4096</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d_{T}=4096</annotation></semantics></math>, which cannot be scored directly against a <math id="S4.SS4.p5.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="2048" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>2048</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2048</annotation></semantics></math>-dimensional student vector. A bias-free linear map <math id="S4.SS4.p5.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B_{\mathrm{aux}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{T}\times 2048}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>aux</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mrow><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mn>2048</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B_{\mathrm{aux}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{T}\times 2048}</annotation></semantics></math>, initialized orthogonally, sends the student mean vector into the teacher space. The point term is one minus the cosine. The batch term is a smoothed <math id="S4.SS4.p5.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\ell_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ell_{1}</annotation></semantics></math> loss between the query–document cosine matrices. <math id="S4.SS4.p5.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B_{\mathrm{aux}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>aux</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B_{\mathrm{aux}}</annotation></semantics></math> is discarded after training, and inference uses the Prefix-MRL head.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.p6.1" class="ltx_p">At each step the narrow branch clusters candidates using budget <math id="S4.SS4.p6.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="K=64" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>K</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>64</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">K=64</annotation></semantics></math> with probability <math id="S4.SS4.p6.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.3</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.3</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S4.SS4.p6.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="K=128" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>K</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>128</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">K=128</annotation></semantics></math> with probability <math id="S4.SS4.p6.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.7" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.7</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.7</annotation></semantics></math>. Cluster assignment is held fixed. The mean inside a cluster and the normalization that follows it receive gradient. Every token in a cluster receives the same share <math id="S4.SS4.p6.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1/|C_{k}|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>C</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1/|C_{k}|</annotation></semantics></math> of the centroid gradient. The step loss is</p>
<table id="S4.E7" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.E7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{step}}=\frac{1}{2}\big(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ret}}^{(64)}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ret}}^{(2048)}\big)+\lambda_{\mathrm{kd}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{kd}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{aux}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{bridge}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>step</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>ret</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>64</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msubsup><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>ret</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2048</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>kd</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>kd</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>aux</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>bridge</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{step}}=\frac{1}{2}\big(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ret}}^{(64)}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ret}}^{(2048)}\big)+\lambda_{\mathrm{kd}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{kd}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{aux}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{bridge}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(7)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S4.SS4.p6.2" class="ltx_p">The <math id="S4.SS4.p6.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d=64" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>64</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d=64</annotation></semantics></math> branch scores centroids. The <math id="S4.SS4.p6.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d=2048" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2048</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d=2048</annotation></semantics></math> branch scores the full sequence.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS5" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">4.5 </span>Query-side saliency gate and noise floor</h3>

<div id="S4.SS5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Uniform MaxSim, with <math id="S4.SS5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w_{i}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w_{i}=1</annotation></semantics></math> on every non-pad token, fails on multimodal queries for two reasons. Visual patches and background tokens dominate the sum, and every query token can find a medium inner product on any candidate. Those medium matches add up and dilute the real hit.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS5.p2.1" class="ltx_p">The gate starts from the uniform weights <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w_{i}^{(0)}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w_{i}^{(0)}</annotation></semantics></math>. Its input is ten domain-free features <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\phi_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>ϕ</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\phi_{i}</annotation></semantics></math> of each token: the pre-normalization norm, deviation from the query mean direction, difference from the neighboring token, uniqueness inside the query, modality and position marks, and the query length. A two-layer SiLU network produces a score <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>g</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g_{i}</annotation></semantics></math>. A linear term on the token direction carries an <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\ell_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ell_{2}</annotation></semantics></math> penalty. The weights are then</p>
<table id="S4.E8" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.E8.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{i}=\exp\!\big(\tau_{\mathrm{gate}}\tanh(g_{i})\big),\qquad w_{i}=\frac{L_{q}\,w_{i}^{(0)}m_{i}}{\sum_{j=1}^{L_{q}}w_{j}^{(0)}m_{j}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.370em;" width="1.370em"><mi>exp</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>τ</mi><mi>gate</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>tanh</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>g</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>q</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>q</mi></msub></msubsup><mrow><msubsup><mi>w</mi><mi>j</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>j</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{i}=\exp\!\big(\tau_{\mathrm{gate}}\tanh(g_{i})\big),\qquad w_{i}=\frac{L_{q}\,w_{i}^{(0)}m_{i}}{\sum_{j=1}^{L_{q}}w_{j}^{(0)}m_{j}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(8)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S4.SS5.p2.2" class="ltx_p">The gate output layer is initialized at zero, so training starts from uniform MaxSim. With <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau_{\mathrm{gate}}=0.6" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>τ</mi><mi>gate</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.6</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau_{\mathrm{gate}}=0.6</annotation></semantics></math>, each token is rescaled between about <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.55" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.55</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.55</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1.8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>1.8</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1.8</annotation></semantics></math>, and the weights still sum to <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{q}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>q</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">L_{q}</annotation></semantics></math>. The gate has <math id="S4.SS5.p2.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="257" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>257</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">257</annotation></semantics></math> parameters.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS5.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS5.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Let <math id="S4.SS5.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{i}=\max_{v\in D}\langle\hat{q}_{i},v\rangle" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>max</mi><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow></msub><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>q</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{i}=\max_{v\in D}\langle\hat{q}_{i},v\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>. The noise-floor score amplifies the part of <math id="S4.SS5.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{i}</annotation></semantics></math> above <math id="S4.SS5.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\theta_{\mathrm{nf}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>nf</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta_{\mathrm{nf}}</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="S4.E9" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.E9.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s_{\mathrm{tok}}(q_{i},D)=r_{i}+\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}\,\operatorname{ReLU}\!\big(r_{i}-\theta_{\mathrm{nf}}\big),\qquad s(Q,D)=\sum_{i=1}^{L_{q}}w_{i}\,s_{\mathrm{tok}}(q_{i},D)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>tok</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>q</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>nf</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:2.535em;" width="2.535em"><mi>ReLU</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>nf</mi></msub></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>Q</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>q</mi></msub></munderover><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>tok</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>q</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s_{\mathrm{tok}}(q_{i},D)=r_{i}+\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}\,\operatorname{ReLU}\!\big(r_{i}-\theta_{\mathrm{nf}}\big),\qquad s(Q,D)=\sum_{i=1}^{L_{q}}w_{i}\,s_{\mathrm{tok}}(q_{i},D).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(9)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S4.SS5.p3.2" class="ltx_p">Matches below the floor are unchanged. Matches above it are multiplied by <math id="S4.SS5.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1+\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>nf</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1+\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}</annotation></semantics></math> on the excess only. <math id="S4.SS5.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>nf</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}=0</annotation></semantics></math> recovers equation <a href="#S1.E1" title="In 1.1 From a single vector to multi-vector retrieval ‣ 1 Introduction ‣ OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1</span></a>. <math id="S4.SS5.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s_{\mathrm{tok}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>tok</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s_{\mathrm{tok}}</annotation></semantics></math> is monotone in <math id="S4.SS5.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{i}</annotation></semantics></math>. The argmax cluster is the same as in standard MaxSim, and Section <a href="#S7.SS5" title="7.5 Localizing the hit ‣ 7 Three-stage retrieval ‣ OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">7.5</span></a> localizes with that cluster.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS5.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS5.p4.1" class="ltx_p">On the unit sphere in <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>d</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d</annotation></semantics></math> dimensions, a query token and a random centroid have an inner product of mean <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0</annotation></semantics></math> and variance <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1/d" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1/d</annotation></semantics></math>. The expected maximum over <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="K" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>K</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">K</annotation></semantics></math> centroids is at most</p>
<table id="S4.E10" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S4.E10.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}\Big[\max_{1\leq j\leq K}\langle\hat{q}_{i},v_{j}\rangle\Big]\;\leq\;\sqrt{\frac{2\ln K}{d}}\;=\;\sqrt{\frac{2\ln 128}{64}}\;\approx\;0.389." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">[</mo><mrow><munder><mi>max</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>j</mi><mo>≤</mo><mi>K</mi></mrow></munder><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>q</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>j</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em" rspace="0.280em">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><msqrt><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mi>K</mi></mrow></mrow><mi>d</mi></mfrac></msqrt><mo lspace="0.558em" rspace="0.558em">=</mo><msqrt><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mn>128</mn></mrow></mrow><mn>64</mn></mfrac></msqrt><mo lspace="0.558em">≈</mo><mn> 0.389</mn></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}\Big[\max_{1\leq j\leq K}\langle\hat{q}_{i},v_{j}\rangle\Big]\;\leq\;\sqrt{\frac{2\ln K}{d}}\;=\;\sqrt{\frac{2\ln 128}{64}}\;\approx\;0.389.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(10)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S4.SS5.p4.2" class="ltx_p">An unrelated record therefore contributes about <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.389" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.389</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.389</annotation></semantics></math> per query token. The floor is set to <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\theta_{\mathrm{nf}}=0.38" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>nf</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.38</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta_{\mathrm{nf}}=0.38</annotation></semantics></math>. On ViDoRe V3 the measured mean of <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{i}</annotation></semantics></math> is <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.393" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.393</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.393</annotation></semantics></math> on unrelated pages and <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.694" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.694</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.694</annotation></semantics></math> on relevant pages, and <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="92\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>92</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">92\%</annotation></semantics></math> of tokens on relevant pages exceed <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.38" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.38</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.38</annotation></semantics></math>. With <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}=2.5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>nf</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>2.5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{\mathrm{nf}}=2.5</annotation></semantics></math>, a token at the relevant-page mean is scored about <math id="S4.SS5.p4.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="3.8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>3.8</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3.8</annotation></semantics></math> times the unrelated-page mean, while a match near the floor is almost unchanged. The noise floor is computed in S3 (Section <a href="#S7" title="7 Three-stage retrieval ‣ OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">7</span></a>).</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="S5" class="ltx_section">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">5 </span>Block-wise model merging</h2>

<section id="S5.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">5.1 </span>What is merged</h3>

<div id="S5.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The weights are a merge of the models trained across stages. One level averages full-data runs that share a starting point, and averages neighboring stages. After stage 3, a second level trains specialists for video, fine-grained entities, visual question answering, and tool use, then adds their deltas back to the trunk (Figure <a href="#S5.F4" title="Figure 4 ‣ 5.1 What is merged ‣ 5 Block-wise model merging ‣ OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4</span></a>). Each ability is trained on its own data and added in parameter space <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">[<a href="#bib.bib34" title="" class="ltx_ref">10</a>]</cite>.</p>
</div>
<figure id="S5.F4" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2611.32203v1/figures/fig3_merge.png" id="S5.F4.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:476/257;" width="476" height="257" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 4: </span>Two-level block-wise merge. (a) Full-data variants from one start, and weights from neighboring rounds, are averaged with one coefficient per block into the trunk <math id="S5.F4.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>P</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P</annotation></semantics></math>. (b) Four specialists add <math id="S5.F4.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta_{k}=\theta^{(k)}-P" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>θ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>P</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta_{k}=\theta^{(k)}-P</annotation></semantics></math>, weighted per block; bar length is <math id="S5.F4.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{k,b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>c</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{k,b}</annotation></semantics></math>. Text and tool specialists set the vision and merger coefficients to <math id="S5.F4.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0</annotation></semantics></math>, and language-layer deltas are trimmed by <math id="S5.F4.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}_{\rho}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi><mi>ρ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{T}_{\rho}</annotation></semantics></math>. (c) The per-block policy after the merge.</figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S5.SS1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.SS1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Parameters are split into five blocks <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="b\in\{\mathrm{vis},\mathrm{merger},\mathrm{vocab},\mathrm{llm},\mathrm{head}\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mi>vis</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>merger</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>vocab</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>llm</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>head</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">b\in\{\mathrm{vis},\mathrm{merger},\mathrm{vocab},\mathrm{llm},\mathrm{head}\}</annotation></semantics></math>: the vision encoder, the merger, the token embedding, the language layers, and the Prefix-MRL head. Let <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>P</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P</annotation></semantics></math> be the trunk and <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\theta^{(k)}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>θ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta^{(k)}</annotation></semantics></math> the <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>k</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k</annotation></semantics></math>-th model. The delta is <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta_{k}=\theta^{(k)}-P" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>θ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>P</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta_{k}=\theta^{(k)}-P</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta_{k,b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta_{k,b}</annotation></semantics></math> is its restriction to block <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="b" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>b</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">b</annotation></semantics></math>. The merged block is</p>
<table id="S5.E11" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S5.E11.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\theta_{b}=P_{b}+\sum_{k=1}^{M}c_{k,b}\,\mathcal{T}_{\rho}\!\left(\Delta_{k,b}\right),\qquad c_{k,b}\in[0,1]." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>b</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>P</mi><mi>b</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">+</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>M</mi></munderover><mrow><msub><mi>c</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi><mi>ρ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>c</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta_{b}=P_{b}+\sum_{k=1}^{M}c_{k,b}\,\mathcal{T}_{\rho}\!\left(\Delta_{k,b}\right),\qquad c_{k,b}\in[0,1].</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(11)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S5.SS1.p2.2" class="ltx_p">A uniform average is the special case in which every block shares one coefficient. A text or tool specialist takes coefficient <math id="S5.SS1.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0</annotation></semantics></math> on the vision encoder and the merger, and a positive coefficient on the language layers. In Figure <a href="#S5.F4" title="Figure 4 ‣ 5.1 What is merged ‣ 5 Block-wise model merging ‣ OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4</span></a> the length of a bar is that coefficient. The vision bar of a text or tool specialist is empty because the coefficient is zero.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.SS1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.SS1.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.SS1.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}_{\rho}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi><mi>ρ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{T}_{\rho}</annotation></semantics></math> keeps the largest-magnitude fraction <math id="S5.SS1.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>ρ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho</annotation></semantics></math> of each tensor and zeros the rest <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">[<a href="#bib.bib35" title="" class="ltx_ref">38</a>]</cite>:</p>
<table id="S5.E12" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S5.E12.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}_{\rho}(\Delta)_{j}=\begin{cases}\Delta_{j},&amp;|\Delta_{j}|\geq\tau_{\rho},\\
0,&amp;\text{otherwise},\end{cases}" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi><mi>ρ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi>j</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd class="ltx_align_left" columnalign="left"><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>,</mo></mrow></mtd><mtd class="ltx_align_left" columnalign="left"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>≥</mo><msub><mi>τ</mi><mi>ρ</mi></msub></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd class="ltx_align_left" columnalign="left"><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></mrow></mtd><mtd class="ltx_align_left" columnalign="left"><mrow><mtext>otherwise</mtext><mo>,</mo></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{T}_{\rho}(\Delta)_{j}=\begin{cases}\Delta_{j},&amp;|\Delta_{j}|\geq\tau_{\rho},\\
0,&amp;\text{otherwise},\end{cases}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(12)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S5.SS1.p3.2" class="ltx_p">where <math id="S5.SS1.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau_{\rho}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>τ</mi><mi>ρ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau_{\rho}</annotation></semantics></math> is the <math id="S5.SS1.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(1-\rho)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1-\rho)</annotation></semantics></math>-quantile of <math id="S5.SS1.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\Delta|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\Delta|</annotation></semantics></math>. Most entries in a specialist delta are small and close to random. They add little to the target ability and interfere with other specialists. Language-layer deltas use <math id="S5.SS1.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho=0.75" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.75</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho=0.75</annotation></semantics></math>. Vision, merger, and head deltas use <math id="S5.SS1.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho=1</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S5.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">5.2 </span>Per-block coefficients</h3>

<div id="S5.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A second-order expansion writes the extra loss of one coefficient shared by every block. Consider a single model, with trimmed block delta <math id="S5.SS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta_{b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>δ</mi><mi>b</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta_{b}</annotation></semantics></math> and coefficient <math id="S5.SS2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>b</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{b}</annotation></semantics></math>. Let <math id="S5.SS2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>g</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S5.SS2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>H</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H</annotation></semantics></math> be the gradient and Hessian of the loss at <math id="S5.SS2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>P</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P</annotation></semantics></math>, and ignore cross-block second derivatives. The loss after the merge is approximately</p>
<table id="S5.E13" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S5.E13.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}(\theta)\approx\mathcal{L}(P)+\sum_{b}\Big(a_{b}\,c_{b}+\frac{1}{2}h_{b}\,c_{b}^{2}\Big),\qquad a_{b}=g_{b}^{\top}\delta_{b},\quad h_{b}=\delta_{b}^{\top}H_{bb}\,\delta_{b}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi rspace="0em">∑</mo><mi>b</mi></munder><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em"
